title: Signal: pip configuration points at a cleartext index
scope: A pip.conf file that declares a `pip.conf` index URL that uses cleartext http.
limitations: It matches a `pip.conf` index URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed pip.conf; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pip.conf that mentions a `pip.conf` index URL that uses cleartext http in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
